item.title: Village Housing Plans Approved Despite Opposition
item.description: Plans for major housing developments in two Harborough villages have been approved, despite opposition. item.description: Harborough District Council will take no further action after a mobile phone mast it owned was removed without permission. item.title: Appeal After Burglary In Stoke Albany
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a burglary in Stoke Albany. item.title: Market Harborough BMX Freestyler Wins World Cup Title
item.description: Market Harborough BMX Freestyler Jude Jones is celebrating the biggest win of his career. The 24-year-old triumphed at the UCI World Cup in Japan last weekend, becoming the only British competitor to ever take the title. item.description: A young diver from Market Harborough has earned a coveted place in Swim England’s Diving Youth Development Squad. Ten-year-old Sebastian Karanjit is one of just eleven promising athletes selected for the two-year pathway, designed to nurture future junior elite competitors. item.title: Car Left In Precarious Position At Saddington Reservoir
item.description: Police were called after a car was left in a precarious position at Saddington Reservoir. The vehicle ended up partially submerged at the water’s edge on Tuesday. Officers attended the scene and have described the incident as a ‘genuine accident’. No-one was injured.
